mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the slowing industrial sector weighs on the broader economy.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 50 but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as the UNRATE rising by more than 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period, signals a rapidly weakening labor market and impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp over 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, indicating a restrictive monetary policy stance, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs weigh on economic activity and corporate profits.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) are in year-over-year decline, it signals broad-based weakness in consumer demand that will weigh on corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS in y-o-y decline but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is accelerating, it signals a tight labor market that will put upward pressure on wages and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed responds with tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS accelerating but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals an inflationary environment that will lead to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher borrowing costs weigh on economic activity.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is in year-over-year decline and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3%, it signals a combination of supply-side weakness and restrictive monetary policy that will weigh on economic activity and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO in y-o-y decline and FEDFUNDS > 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.
